episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Adelina Tattilo is betrayed by her husband, leaving her in charge of his erotic magazine — and responsible for its sudden entanglement with the law.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Thrust into her new role, Adelina faces money troubles at home and at work, and must decide whether to exploit a tragedy to keep the magazine afloat.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: As the magazine battles stiff competition, Adelina targets a demure TV host to be its new cover star. Chartroux takes a meeting behind the editor's back.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A new kind of model in the office catches Adelina's eye. Elsa tries to promote a product which could get Playmen into even more trouble with the law.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A journalist touts photos of Jackie Kennedy Onassis which could destroy her reputation, but secure Playmen's future. Both Adelina and Elsa go on dates.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Divorce papers in hand, Adelina travels to Nice to ask Saro for help. Over dinner, she encounters a famous face featured in her own magazine.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The future of Playmen hangs in the balance. As Elsa desperately looks for a new angle to use in the trial, Adelina gets distracted by a family emergency.
